description: Use when an agent needs a normalized profile of a South Korean company for KYB, research or sales. Input: id (companyId from /v1/kr/company/resolve). Output: JSON English-keyed profile: names, business/corporate/DART/stock identifiers, market, KSIC industry code, founding date, fiscal year end, address, homepage, KONEPS supplier registration (type, business lines, employees). No CEO names. Data: OpenDART, KONEPS. Example: ?id=kr-dart-00126380 Price: $0.0045 USDC via x402.
name: kr_company_profile
title: Korean company profile: DART registry data joined with its public-procurement vendor record
